verdict.rationale: The docs show documents can be added to an existing index (meilisearch-docs-2, docs-13), and Meilisync offers automatic database sync (docs-71), which implies incremental indexing rather than full rebuilds. Community reports conflict on freshness: some praise fast indexing (comm-10, comm-6), while others say indexing fell hours behind for constantly changing records (comm-4) and writes were hard to scale (comm-13). There is no vendor claim of near-real-time searchability for these reports to contradict, so this stays partial rather than disputed. Missing for 10: documented support for updates and deletes, any stated indexing latency or near-real-time guarantee, and evidence that incremental changes avoid reindexing under heavy write load.
